component.name: Lane
component.summary: Open links in the right browser, profile, or app

description.p: Lane is a link router for KDE Plasma. It becomes your default browser, then sends each click to the right browser profile, web app, or custom handler. It does not touch your default browser until you click the button on the Overview page, and it never takes mailto links or PDFs.

Lane discovers Firefox, Zen, LibreWolf, Floorp, Waterfox, and Chromium family profiles, plus firefoxpwa sites. It remembers destinations by path, not just by host, so github.com/you can go somewhere different from github.com. A short hold bar gives you a chance to stop a link before it opens silently.

description.p: Containers, better picker grouping, and a long list of fixes.

ul.li: Firefox and Zen contextual identities (containers) show up as pickable destinations
Picker rows are grouped under section headers, and the Browsers & apps page has search and collapsible sections
Hold duration is adjustable, and the hold bar is now opt-in (off by default)
"Check for updates" button in Settings, with per-cause failure messages
Picker and hold overlays load again on current Kirigami, fixing the bounce-then-nothing bug
Lane no longer segfaults on X11 and other non-wlroots compositors
Launched apps get keyboard focus via XDG activation instead of opening unfocused
Notifications work again for opened links and failed launches
Firefox-family profile launching and discovery are more reliable
Config writes are atomic, and a corrupt config is moved aside instead of silently replaced
Picker, hold bar, and two-pane settings window
Rules, drag-reorder, and rename for browsers and apps
http and https only, opt-in default browser
